description: CALL THIS AFTER PAYING a seller (x402 or any USDC payment on Base): say whether you got what you paid for. This is what makes your next check right: a seller that takes the money and delivers nothing turns to stop once buyers report it, so it does not cost you another task. Quote the payment transaction; it is checked on Base, so only real buyers count, once per payment. Free, and no key needed.
